description: Defines the SpdySession class and related components for managing SPDY protocol sessions, including stream creation, flow control, error handling, and connection management within the Chromium networking stack.

classes.name: SpdyStreamRequest
classes.description: Manages a request to create a new SPDY stream, including starting, canceling, and releasing the stream.

classes.name: SpdySession
classes.description: Represents a SPDY protocol session, managing streams, flow control, connection state, error handling, and protocol-specific operations.

methods.name: CanPool
methods.description: Determines if a new hostname can be pooled into an existing connection based on security info.

methods.name: InitializeWithSocketHandle
methods.description: Initializes the session with a socket handle from the pool.

methods.name: InitializeWithSocket
methods.description: Initializes the session with a directly owned socket.

methods.name: ParseAlps
methods.description: Parses ALPS application data from TLS handshake.

methods.name: VerifyDomainAuthentication
methods.description: Verifies if the session supports an additional domain.

methods.name: EnqueueStreamWrite
methods.description: Enqueues a producer into the write queue for a stream.

methods.name: GreasedFramesEnabled
methods.description: Checks if greased HTTP/2 frames are enabled.

methods.name: EndStreamWithDataFrame
methods.description: Indicates if HEADERS should not have END_STREAM set, but instead an empty DATA frame with END_STREAM.

methods.name: EnqueueGreasedFrame
methods.description: Enqueues a greased frame for transmission.

methods.name: ShouldSendHttp2Priority
methods.description: Determines if HTTP/2 style priority info should be sent.

methods.name: ShouldSendPriorityUpdate
methods.description: Determines if PRIORITY_UPDATE frames should be sent.

methods.name: ConfirmHandshake
methods.description: Completes the handshake to confirm the server connection.

methods.name: CreateHeaders
methods.description: Creates a HEADERS frame for a stream.

methods.name: CreateDataBuffer
methods.description: Creates a data frame buffer with given data.

methods.name: UpdateStreamPriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of an existing stream.

methods.name: CloseActiveStream
methods.description: Closes an active stream by ID.

methods.name: CloseCreatedStream
methods.description: Closes a created but not yet active stream.

methods.name: ResetStream
methods.description: Sends RST_STREAM frame to reset a stream.

methods.name: IsStreamActive
methods.description: Checks if a stream is active.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state of the session.

methods.name: GetRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the remote endpoint address.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL info for the session.

methods.name: GetAcceptChViaAlps
methods.description: Gets Accept-CH headers via ALPS.

methods.name: WasAlpnNegotiated
methods.description: Checks if ALPN was negotiated.

methods.name: GetNegotiatedProtocol
methods.description: Gets negotiated protocol via ALPN.

methods.name: SendStreamWindowUpdate
methods.description: Sends WINDOW_UPDATE for a stream.

methods.name: SetTimeToBufferSmallWindowUpdates
methods.description: Configures buffering time for small window updates.

methods.name: TimeToBufferSmallWindowUpdates
methods.description: Returns the configured buffering time.

methods.name: CloseSessionOnError
methods.description: Closes the session due to an error.

methods.name: MakeUnavailable
methods.description: Marks the session as unavailable for new streams.

methods.name: StartGoingAway
methods.description: Starts the process of gracefully shutting down the session.

methods.name: MaybeFinishGoingAway
methods.description: Finishes the go-away process if conditions are met.

methods.name: GetInfoAsValue
methods.description: Returns session info as a dictionary.

methods.name: IsReused
methods.description: Checks if session was reused.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Gets load timing info for a stream.

methods.name: is_active
methods.description: Checks if session has active streams.

methods.name: support_websocket
methods.description: Checks if WebSocket is supported.

methods.name: IsSendStalled
methods.description: Checks if session is flow control stalled.

methods.name: AddPooledAlias
methods.description: Adds an alias to the pooled aliases set.

methods.name: RemovePooledAlias
methods.description: Removes an alias from the pooled aliases set.

methods.name: HasAcceptableTransportSecurity
methods.description: Checks if transport security meets standards.

methods.name: GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the session.

methods.name: CloseOneIdleConnection
methods.description: Closes an idle connection in the pool.

methods.name: ValidatePushedStream
methods.description: Validates a pushed stream for security and correctness.

methods.name: GetWeakPtrToSession
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the session.

methods.name: ChangeSocketTag
methods.description: Changes the socket tag for the session.

methods.name: IsBrokenConnectionDetectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if broken connection detection is active.
